notes: Sarita Handa: genuine New Arrivals concept is a top-level main-nav item 'NEW IN' at /new-arrivals.html, a real browsable PLP (Magento layered-nav grid, sortable, toolbar count) -- not an editorial/lookbook page. Meta description confirms it is an actual product listing ('Sarita Handa presents a spectacular array of their new arrivals in...pillow covers and...spreads'). It has 5 live sub-listings in the main nav: Cushions, Bedspreads, Furniture, Fabrics, Decor (checked both header mega-menu and footer copies of the nav, identical set; no hidden/commented-out extra sub-listing found, unlike the Clearance/'The Final Few' case). All qty values are Magento 'Items <toolbar-number>' counts, independently verified exact (not capped/inflated) by walking pagination to the arithmetic last page: main listing page 66 = 12 items, page 67 = 3 items -> 66*12+3 = 795, matches toolbar-number exactly (page 68 wraps/repeats, so not used as evidence); Cushions sub-listing page 36 = 9 items -> 35*12+9 = 429, matches; Fabrics sub-listing page 1 = 12, page 2 = 4 -> 16, matches. Bedspreads (127), Furniture (151) and Decor (60) were read directly from the toolbar on their own pages (not separately pagination-walked, given the consistent exactness of every other sample on this site) -- if stricter verification is wanted, flag for a follow-up pagination check. Sum of the 5 children (429+127+151+16+60=783) is 12 short of the parent total (795); no dead/hidden 6th sub-listing was found to explain it (unlike Clearance's Table Linen case), so the gap is most likely new-arrival products that sit in categories with no dedicated New-Arrivals sub-page (e.g. Gifting, Lighting, Table Linen, Wall Covering, Bath & Wellness all have New Arrivals stock visible on individual PDPs but no /new-arrivals/<category>.html page exists for them). This does not affect the accuracy of the qty recorded for each row, which was read/verified against its own live page.
